traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: No certificate number was visible anywhere in the extracted pages (cover page does not list a distinct certificate number like '3M 01/XX-XX/XXA'; only COFRAC accreditation number N°1-0144 is present, which is not a certificate number for the method). The relative trueness study (Appendix 5) only reports a single food category ('Category 1') covering all tested raw poultry and ready-to-cook poultry products (turkey, chicken, guinea fowl, cockerel, duck, quail, pigeon items) - there was no further sub-categorization into multiple ISO 16140-2 categories; 'Average all categories' and 'Category 1' rows were identical (n=17, bias=0.24, SD=0.58, 95% CI -1.03 to 1.51), confirming only one real category was tested. Two variants of the alternative method incubation protocol were tested (44h alone, and 44h+48h at 5°C storage) - both gave identical summary statistics (bias 0.24, SD 0.58, n=17, CI -1.03/1.51 vs -1.02/1.51), so I used the 44h protocol's values (rounded, functionally identical). The Acceptability Limit of ±0.5 log CFU/g is explicitly stated multiple times (Table 15, Table 16, Section 5 Conclusion) as required by EN ISO 16140-2:2016.
